text: Coursera completed its merger with Udemy on 11 May 2026: each Udemy share was converted into the right to receive 0.800 Coursera shares, and Udemy became a wholly owned subsidiary of Coursera.
short: Udemy has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Coursera since May 2026.

source.name: Coursera – Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: each issued and outstanding share of Udemy common stock was converted into the right to receive 0.800 shares of our common stock, and Udemy became a wholly owned subsidiary of Coursera

additionalSources.name: Coursera – Coursera Completes Combination with Udemy to Build the World’s Most Comprehensive Skills Platform (press release)
additionalSources.quote: Coursera, Inc. (NYSE: COUR) today announced the completion of its combination with Udemy, Inc.
